execution_chronology_audit.audit_objective: Forensic timeline audit of the 10 event-time causality dimensions governing Guardian Alpha execution.

event_chronology_table.evidence_source: NYSE/NASDAQ Official Closing Cross; agent.py closing price reference
event_chronology_table.description: Cash session for trading day T-1 ends. Primary exchange closing auction prices are established.
Vendor publishes adjusted EOD bars including split/dividend factors. Exact arrival timestamp in prospective environment is UNKNOWN until live network feed is established.
Signal evaluated on market_state strictly restricted to bars with ts <= T-1. S_{T-1} regime state and target weights w_T are determined.

event_chronology_table.evidence_source: Vendor ToS and corporate action schemas
event_chronology_table.description: Vendors may retroactively adjust historical prices for unannounced dividends or amended splits. The causal protocol mandates that once a signal is computed from a snapshot, retroactive adjustments are quarantined and not applied retroactively to already executed orders.
Order batch is locked and cryptographically nonced with UUIDv5 client order IDs.
Orders queued for Market Open auction.

event_chronology_table.evidence_source: preview.py: lines 106-136 ('Fill yesterday orders at today open')
event_chronology_table.description: All rebalance orders emitted based on T-1 close execute deterministically at Session T Open price with slippage penalty.

event_chronology_table.event_time_est: 09:30:00 EST to 16:00:00 EST on Session T
event_chronology_table.evidence_source: preview.py: lines 138-144 ('Mark to market on today close')
event_chronology_table.description: Portfolio return is evaluated over the open-to-close (or close-to-close with open execution) interval of session T.
Session T eligibility depends strictly on S_{T-1}. Same-day session T market return R_{m,T} is completely absent from the eligibility decision.
Any vendor EOD bar for session T-1 arriving after 09:15:00 EST on session T is classified as QUARANTINED_LATE. The trading runner aborts order submission and freezes execution.

execution_chronology_audit.causal_pass_qualification: While simulated execution timing at T+1 open is verified in preview.py and host contracts, exact prospective vendor arrival timestamps are UNKNOWN prior to live feed instrumentation. Therefore, causal chronology is qualified as CONDITIONAL upon pre-market feed arrival confirmation.
